goal: Allow the historical preview-ready terminalizer to select its exact preview artifact when the same successful run also emitted the normal automatic production review-evidence artifact; keep all manifest, target, no-ledger-delta and artifact identity refusals.
prohibited_actions: Do not apply a migration or change production or preview database data
Do not accept unknown, duplicate, expired, or cross-run artifacts
Do not relax the exact historical manifest, marker, log, or unchanged-ledger proof
assumptions: Successful historical preview rebind run 36388097766 emitted both the exact preview artifact and normal automatic review evidence under the same run and main SHA.
The terminalizer currently refuses any artifact count other than one, preventing a valid outcome record.
stop_conditions: Stop if a mismatched or unknown artifact would be accepted
Stop if the governed review or required checks refuse
